incidents.message: Teamwork Desk have been restored to normal. There was an issue processing some unusual inbound email that has been resolved, both for now and any future occurrence.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of Teamwork Spaces being offline
incidents.message:
Teamwork Spaces is responding normally in our US region now. A temporary issue caused the app to lose its connection to its CDN resulting it page load issues.
Services have been restarted now and Spaces is operating normally.

incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

We are currently investigating issues with Teamwork in our US region
incidents.message: We received some higher than usual traffic to one of our databases, impacting on performance for a number of customers.  We have resolved this issue now and performance is back to normal.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of issues logging in to new accounts in our EU region
incidents.message: New accounts in our EU region are operating normally now. A database issue was undetected causing issues for replicating new account information. This has now been solved.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow response times from Teamwork in our US region
incidents.message: One of our databases clusters was experiencing higher than normal traffic and we have scaled up a little to compensate.  We will continue to monitor.

incidents.name: We are investigating time outs for users of custom domains in the EU region
incidents.message: Custom domains in the EU region are operating normally now. A configuration error was found and removed.

incidents.message: A change in the homepage caused a redirect which also caused its health check to fail. This change has been reverted and the site is online again.
